summary: harvester-finish-operations-and-interpretation-docs (3 sessions) closed Phase 4 Criterion #6: authored the downstream-AI-consumer-facing interpretation guide (docs/harvester/interpretation-guide.md, ~5,000 words across 10 sections), the docs-index pointer page (docs/README.md), added a link from the top-level README to both, and regenerated examples/*.json from the canonical golden corpus (verbatim copies of HomeHealthCare/ir/Forms/frmReportParam_ClientFY.ir.json, frmServiceDetail.ir.json, and NorthwindDevEdition/manifest.json) after Session 3's downstream-AI probe surfaced the spec's 'Out-of-date examples' stop rule.
